newsitem.title: USA: Chartwell Re, LDG in alliance.
newsitem.headline: Chartwell Re, LDG in alliance.

text.p: Chartwell Re Corp said Tuesday that it has formed a strategic alliance with LDG Management Co, a subsidiary of HCC Insurance Holdings Inc, in which Chartwell will provide licensed casualty reinsurance capacity for four of the underwriting pools currently managed by LDG.
Chartwell said that this alliance will give LDG's reinsurance clients the ability to choose between a single casualty reinsurer or the accident and health reinsurance pool capacity currently offered.
Chartwell will become an underwriting participant in the three LDG reinsurance pools in which it does not currently participate in addition to expanding its existing participation on the other pool.
The company will receive fronting fees on business where it issues contracts for LDG pools.
